name: Liqoria
tagline: Give your music an animated now-playing display with artwork and playback controls.
description:
Liqoria turns the music playing on a Mac into an animated visual experience inspired by Apple's full-screen player. It follows the current track, artwork, and playback state while providing a polished control surface for several music sources.

## Features

- Display animated album artwork and track information in a full-screen, windowed, or compact presentation.
- Control play, pause, skipping, volume, and the current timeline from the visual player.
- Work with Apple Music, Spotify, YouTube, Cider, web browsers, and other media applications exposed through macOS Control Center.
- Adapt colors and visual treatment to the current artwork.
- Use a Liquid Glass-styled interface designed for modern macOS.
- Try the complete experience before buying.

## Where it fits

Liqoria is for listeners who want their Mac to become a now-playing display while music runs in the background. It complements rather than replaces a streaming service: library management, discovery, accounts, and playback availability still come from the source app.

## Privacy and requirements

Liqoria supports macOS 15.4 or later. It reads system media information needed to identify and control the current track. The developer's privacy policy says the app does not collect personal data. Music services and browsers retain their own privacy practices.

## Pricing

Liqoria costs $8.90 as a one-time purchase. A free trial of up to 72 hours is available.
